title: Your Disk Is Full. But Full of What?
description:
disktree, a free and open-source app from Shopify founder Tobi Lütke, draws every folder as a box sized by what it really costs on disk. Hatched boxes are space you can get back (caches, build output). Mark them, review the list, and only then delete. Linux, macOS and Windows.

Full breakdown: {main_url}

Source: https://github.com/tobi/disktree
The home folder shown is an illustrative example. Narrated with an AI voice. Animated in code.
